description: Simulation Data for Basin Amplification Effects on Bridge Seismic Performance under M9 Cascadia Subduction Zone Earthquakes is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "simulation", published or maintained by Anqi Shen, University of British Columbia (ubc.ca). Bridges in Metro Vancouver may experience severe seismic demands during M9 Cascadia Subduction Zone earthquakes because of the region’s proximity to the rupture zone and its location above the Georgia sedimentary basin. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "simulation" project. Keywords: bridge seismic performance, Cascadia Subduction Zone, basin amplification effects, site-response analysis, regional seismic assessment. Published 2026-05-15. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
